description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases for verifying the handling of repository corruption scenarios in Git. It defines functions to simulate corruption of git objects, sets up various test repositories with intentional corruptions or missing objects, and runs Git commands to ensure they fail appropriately when encountering such corruptions.

methods.name: obj_to_file
methods.description: Converts a git object reference into its corresponding file path within the .git/objects directory.

methods.name: corrupt_byte
methods.description: Corrupts a specific byte in a git object file to simulate corruption.
